items.source: Configure whether the StompBrokerRelayMessageHandler should start automatically when the Spring ApplicationContext is refreshed.
items.translation: 配置是否在刷新 Spring ApplicationContext 时自动启动 StompBrokerRelayMessageHandler。
`StompBrokerRelayRegistration` 类在 `org.springframework.messaging.simp.config` 包中的使用情况。

items.source: Configuration support for WebSocket messaging using higher level messaging protocols.
items.translation: 使用更高级别消息协议支持 WebSocket 消息配置的配置支持。

items.source:
Enable a STOMP broker relay and configure the destination prefixes supported by the
message broker.
items.translation: 启用 STOMP 代理中继并配置消息代理支持的目的地前缀。

items.source:
Set the login to use when creating connections to the STOMP broker on
behalf of connected clients.
items.translation: 设置用于代表已连接客户端创建到 STOMP 代理连接的登录凭据。

items.source:
Set the passcode to use when creating connections to the STOMP broker on
behalf of connected clients.
items.translation: 为连接客户端代表创建到 STOMP 代理的连接时设置使用的密码。

items.source: Set the STOMP message broker host.
items.translation: 设置 STOMP 消息代理主机。

items.source: Set the STOMP message broker port.
items.translation: 设置 STOMP 消息代理端口。

items.source:
Set the maximum interval, in milliseconds, at which the "system" relay session
expects, in the absence of any other data, to receive a heartbeat from the STOMP
broker.
items.translation: 设置“system"中继会话期望接收来自 STOMP 代理心跳的最大间隔（以毫秒为单位），在没有其他数据的情况下。

items.source:
Set the interval, in milliseconds, at which the "system" relay session will,
in the absence of any other data being sent, send a heartbeat to the STOMP broker.
items.translation: 设置“system"中继会话在没有任何其他数据发送的情况下，向 STOMP 代理发送心跳的间隔（以毫秒为单位）。

items.source:
Set the login for the shared "system" connection used to send messages to
the STOMP broker from within the application, i.e.
items.translation: 在应用程序内部设置用于向 STOMP 代理发送消息的共享“system”连接的登录信息，即

items.source:
Set the passcode for the shared "system" connection used to send messages to
the STOMP broker from within the application, i.e.
items.translation: 在应用程序内部设置用于向 STOMP 代理发送消息的共享"system"连接的密码，即：

items.source:
Some STOMP clients (for example, stomp-js) always send heartbeats at a fixed rate
but others (Spring STOMP client) do so only when no other messages are
sent.
items.translation: 某些 STOMP 客户端（例如，stomp-js）始终以固定速率发送心跳，而其他客户端（如 Spring STOMP 客户端）仅在未发送其他消息时才发送心跳。

items.source: Configure a TCP client for managing TCP connections to the STOMP broker.
items.translation: 配置一个用于管理到 STOMP 代理的 TCP 连接的 TCP 客户端。

items.source:
Set a destination to broadcast messages to user destinations that remain
unresolved because the user appears not to be connected.
items.translation: 设置一个目标，以向那些因用户似乎未连接而保持未解析状态的用户目标广播消息。

items.source:
Set a destination to broadcast the content of the local user registry to
and to listen for such broadcasts from other servers.
items.translation: 设置目标以广播本地用户注册表的内容，并监听来自其他服务器的此类广播。

items.source: Set the value of the "host" header to use in STOMP CONNECT frames.
items.translation: 将“host”标头的值设置为要在 STOMP CONNECT 帧中使用的值。
